assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias.
The service is medically necessary consistent with the clinical indication for identifying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-22, indicating that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols.
